description_en: Set the credit control limit for a fund account
description_zh: 设置资金账户的信控限额
name: SetFundAccountCreditAmount

parameters.description_en: Fund account ID. If not specified, the account owned by the current account (owner) is used by default.
parameters.description_zh: 资金账户id, 不设置时默认使用当前账号拥有（owner）的账户
parameters.help_en: Fund account ID. If not specified, the account owned by the current account (owner) is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 资金账户id, 不设置时默认使用当前账号拥有（owner）的账户
parameters.name: fund_account_id

parameters.description_en: Currency for the credit control limit. Currently, only CNY is supported in mainland China, and only USD is supported for international use.
parameters.description_zh: 信控额度币种。目前国内仅支持CNY，国际仅支持USD
parameters.help_en: Currency for the credit control limit. Currently, only CNY is supported in mainland China, and only USD is supported for international use
parameters.help_zh: 信控额度币种。目前国内仅支持CNY，国际仅支持USD
parameters.name: currency
